## Pull request overview

This PR adds an `--until` option to `tidewater export` so a backfill can stop at a chosen instant, mirroring `--since`.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| src/tidewater/export.py | Adds the `until` cutoff to `export_readings`. |
| src/tidewater/cli.py | Adds the `--until` flag and its help text. |
| tests/test_export.py | Covers readings after the cutoff. |
</details>

Copilot reviewed 3 out of 3 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

<details>
<summary>Comments suppressed due to low confidence (1)</summary>

**src/tidewater/export.py:24**
* The `--until` help text and the docstring say the cutoff is inclusive ("up to and including"), but the `>=` comparison skips a reading taken exactly at `until`. A backfill that passes the next run's `--since` instant as `--until` will silently drop that boundary reading.
</details>
